note: n/L/B/levels/effect sizes are an EVALUATION GRID, never proposed or approved research values

methods.U_kernel_raw: existing C6 unstudentized centered CBB (singleton family_reality_check), r/B
methods.S_plus1: studentized CBB bootstrap-t (overlapping circular block LRV; replicate block-sum variance), (r+1)/(B+1); NOT_RUN if fewer than 2 full replicate blocks
methods.BM_t: non-overlapping batch-means t-test, batch length L, df=floor(n/L)-1; NOT_RUN if fewer than 3 batches
